business_summary: Ebara Foods Industry,Inc. produces and sells food condiments in Japan. It offers sauces, and seasoning. The company sells its products under the Golden Taste, Barbecue, Extremely delicious yakiniku, Enjoying yakiniku, Momi, Grated radish, Yakiniku Zaku, Trae Plus, Towada bara-yaki, Pickling mix, Pop-up, Kimchi hot pot base, Sukiyaki, Nabeshabu, Dan Dan Sesame Hot Pot Base, Chinese food, and Yokohana Hakuraitei brand names. EBARA Foods Industry,Inc. was founded in 1958 and is headquartered in Yokohama, Japan.
business_summary_ko: 에바라식품공업(주) 일본에서 식품조미료를 생산, 판매하고 있습니다. 소스와 양념을 제공합니다. 이 회사는 Golden Taste, Barbecue, Extremely Delicious Yakiniku, Enjoying Yakiniku, Momi, Grated Radish, Yakiniku Zaku, Trae Plus, Towada Bara-yaki, Pickling mix, Pop-up, Kimchi hotpot Base, Sukiyaki, Nabeshabu, Dan Dan Sesame Hot Pot Base, Chinese food 및 Yokohana Hakuraitei 브랜드 이름으로 제품을 판매합니다. 에바라식품산업주식회사 1958년에 설립되었으며 일본 요코하마에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
